name: Mandate Related Information 16
definition: Provides further details related to a direct debit mandate signed between the creditor and the debtor.

MandateIdentification.name: Mandate Identification
MandateIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the creditor, to unambiguously identify the mandate.

DateOfSignature.name: Date Of Signature
DateOfSignature.definition: Date on which the direct debit mandate has been signed by the debtor.

AmendmentIndicator.name: Amendment Indicator
AmendmentIndicator.definition: Indicator notifying whether the underlying mandate is amended or not.

AmendmentInformationDetails.name: Amendment Information Details
AmendmentInformationDetails.definition: List of mandate elements that have been modified.

ElectronicSignature.name: Electronic Signature
ElectronicSignature.definition: Additional security provisions, such as a digital signature, as provided by the debtor.

FirstCollectionDate.name: First Collection Date
FirstCollectionDate.definition: Date of the first collection of a direct debit as per the mandate.

FinalCollectionDate.name: Final Collection Date
FinalCollectionDate.definition: Date of the final collection of a direct debit as per the mandate.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Regularity with which direct debit instructions are to be created and processed.

Reason.name: Reason
Reason.definition: Reason for the direct debit mandate to allow the user to distinguish between different mandates for the same creditor.

TrackingDays.name: Tracking Days
TrackingDays.definition: Specifies the number of days the direct debit instruction must be tracked.

AmendmentIndicatorTrueRule.definition: If AmendmentIndicator is true, then AmendmentInformationDetails must be present.

AmendmentIndicatorFalseRule.definition: If AmendmentIndicator is false, then AmendmentInformationDetails is not allowed.
